note: Two independent published gold prices, each stored with the publisher's own timestamp. Neither is an estimate. The calculator lets you replace the price at any time.

primary.label: Gold spot, USD per troy ounce

cross_check.label: COMEX gold futures, front month (GC=F), USD per troy ounce
cross_check.note: Futures price, not spot. Shown only as a cross-check that the spot figure is in the right market range.

disclaimer: A gold price is not an appraisal. Jewellery sells for more than its metal because of labour, setting, stones and margin. Use the melt value only as a floor to spot absurd pricing.
readings_note: Three separate readings of the same published feed, 37 minutes end to end, each stored with the publisher's own timestamp: 4,028.100098 (23:01:42Z), 4,029.699951 (23:22:41Z), 4,026.699951 (23:38:41Z). The latest reading drives the melt arithmetic on this site. Spread across all three readings: 3.60 USD/ozt (0.09%). The melt figures are re-derived from this stored price by scripts/verify.mjs, so changing the price here changes every gold-value figure on the site.
